Intro
Ballas We... are seasons. All of us...
Ballas Growing in the light... fading in the dark...
Ballas At once the same... yet... ever changed.
Cetus Erra Don't be afraid. Kahl-175
Councilor Vay Hek Eight squad! Eight squad! YOU MAGGOTS! REPORT!
Kahl Brothers dead. Only Kahl one-seven-five.
Councilor Vay Hek BROTHER? Brother. The WORMS have swarmed the sector, but we will prevail. Regroup on my beacon.
Kahl F-for... For the Queens!
Kahl Dargyn crash. Kahl help pilot. Kahl finish mission.
Councilor Vay Hek For the Queens. Now... run MAGGOT, RUUUUNNN!
Councilor Vay Hek One-seven-five. The worms close in. Hurry brother!
Councilor Vay Hek Worms have jammed our exfil systems. All ships are grounded.
Kahl Pilot is dead.
Kahl What is mission now?
Councilor Vay Hek Mission? That Bloated Condrix swats us down like flies. We're grounded.
Kahl Kahl stop. Tell Kahl.
Councilor Vay Hek Impossible. Even if you could get close to that thing, they'd eat you alive.
Kahl Eat alive? What if food... is bomb.
Councilor Vay Hek Hmmm. Brother Kahl... yes! Find something with a high enough yield! Hurry!
Kahl For the... Queens.
On Rampart
Kahl This is for Mattac, and Vahn, and Big Borduul!
Kahl You. Are. No. Eidolons!
Kahl For the Queens.
Kahl Searches! Must not see Kahl.
Kahl Kahl sneak good.
Kahl For the Queens.
Kahl For the... Queens.
Councilor Vay Hek There! You are so close! Detonate near enough and your brothers shall live to fight another day!
Kahl For the Queens.
Councilor Vay Hek That's it. Detonate at the base of that Bloated Condrix. FOR GLORY!
. Councilor Vay Hek I salute you, One-Seven-Five. For the Queens!
Kahl For the... huh... For my brothers.
Erra Don't be afraid.
Veso-R Alad V Hold fast to your stations, crews! Our glorious victory is close at hand! Oh, and, uh, any remaining techs aboard, narrow-band me at once!
Veso Confirming tech aboard! Veso-R at your service, most gilded director, most...!
Alad V Yes, yes thank Profit! My command overrides aren't working. I need to break fire control from the fleet. Can you fix that, Veko?
Veso It's Veso, most lucrative and sagacious visionary. Yes, I can try. There's a trace conduit nearby, I can bypass it--
Alad V --Great, yes, do your thing. There's a nice bonus in it if you can.
Veso Hmm. A Breacher Moa could clear that debris. Wonder if the robotics dispenser still functional?
Veso Aah! Why are you shooting at me?
Veso Sir! Veso, here. Our robotics have gone rogue... the Sentients must have latched the grid!
Alad V Someone has, yes. I'll pull some meat-crews to cover you. Just get me that override... um?
Veso Veso. Right. I've got a datapad, secure robot dispenser access... and a Plinx. Right.
Shield Drone Unlocked Veso A functioning shield drone dispenser? Oh, thank Profit.
Veso My shields should hold up, if I'm fast.
Veso There is no shame in maximizing my shields and just running.
Veso No point trying to shoot my way through this.
Veso Their shields are too strong to shoot through. Maybe if I boosted mine somehow.
Striker Moa Unlocked Veso How many hostiles ahead? I can't do this! Unless... I get a Striker Moa.
Targeting turret for attack Veso Turrets look a little less scary now that I've got a Striker Moa.
Veso Hello again, turrets. I've brought a friend this time.
Alad V If I don't stand down fire control soon, we'll all be sucking vacuum! Teko! What's taking so long?
Veso Sir? You want to disengage fire control from the fleet? I... I don't understand.
Alad V Look outside! We'll all about to be under new management! Now do your part or I'll find a more forward-thinking replacement.
Veso There has to be a way to protect that Breacher Moa.
Veso What if I shield that Moa?
Alad V Our... uh... victory is ever-nearer, crew! Your service and sacrifice will be richly rewarded, yes!
Jackal Boss Alad V You see. This is why we need that command override back. The board just can't face reality. So what's your plan, Teso?
Veso Plan? You mean, I have to... Okay. I guess... hit him in the knees? Trigger his a-attack routine? That should leave his shields vulnerable. In theory...
Alad V Clever. Get to it.
Veso Am... am I a traitor to the Board? Yes sir.
Jackal hovers
Veso All his power is going into his attack. Shields vulnerable. Beams incredibly dangerous!
Veso Got to blast those shields while I can!
Veso Drain those shields and that will force his self-repair routine.
If Breacher Moa dies to electric floor
Veso Need to shield that Breacher Moa.
Veso No no, he got blown up too soon!
After Jackal Fight Alad V Just in time, too! Our new management is about to pay a personal visit. Be quick; I've got to stand down fire when they dock with us! Well done, Viko!
Veso Go!
Alad V Attention crew, stand down, all stations. You'll be pleased to know that I, Alad V. have negotiated a peaceful... and profitable... transfer of power to our new--
Veso --Fleet control...
Veso Firing sync reengaged.
Authorization Corpus Tech First Class Veso-R. Take your shot. For Profit.
Railjack Teshin The enemy's eye turns upon our allies. Quickly. Press onward.
Operator We're through the perimeter. You're sure about this? It should be me.
Teshin No, Tenno. Your Warframe will be useless until I clear the Orphix fields. Then we will meet inside.
Operator Teshin. What if the Lotus won't...
Teshin If I must... I can make the harder choice.
Erra How tediously human. A slapdash alliance making a feeble last stand. IF you all crave death in a final flash of glory - I am more than happy to oblige.
Cephalon Cy Boarding party intends to sabotage this ship. Stop them.
Cephalon Cy Intruders cleared.
Operator Cy, Charge the slingshot.
Cephalon Cy You will need to get closer to your mother's ship.
Operator Huh? Did you just--
Cephalon Cy Squadron incoming. The enemy is wise to our diversion.
Cephalon Cy If hull integrity continues to drop this will be a one-way trip.
Cephalon Cy Mothership in range. Problem Slingshot damaged. Crew, hold postion while I route a bypass.
Erra Do you think there's a shred of Lotus left in Natah? All this time, it's been dying. A tumor scorched from its rotting hole.
Cephalon Cy Slingshot patched. Ready to launch.
Operator Teshin... I'll be awaiting... so I can bring her home.
Teshin I'll clear the Orphix, and we'll do it together.
Cephalon Cy Deploying Teshin Dax. Cephalon Ordis to assist.
Teshin Wait, I do not need...
Teshin
Teshin Orphix fields will be scattered--
Ordis The Orphix fields will be scattered deep in the ship. Ordis can help you triangulate them--
Teshin --Quiet!
Ordis I'm only trying to--
Teshin --I don't need your help. Switch off!
Teshin (grumbles)
Ordis Ah! Please excuse Ordis.
Ordis Grineer! Oh my. Ordis wonders what we are getting into.
Ordis Observation a power field requires a power source.
Teshin Hmm? Ordis...
Ordis Yes? Would you like me to dephase that for you?
Teshin (grumbles)
Ordis Swing away, Teshin.
Ballas The Devil sends their relic to do the deed. But then... we're both relics aren't we, old man?
Teshin You shouldn't have come here. You've ruined us both.
Ordis Teshin? Are you - LOSING IT - feeling unwell?
Ordis Ordis is still happy to help!
Teshin Too easy.
Ballas The Tenno freed you from your oath, did they? Does that absolve them of their sins?
Ordis Just one left, and Ordis will be able to safely signal the Operator to join!
Teshin I will decide when it is safe.
Ballas She and her void brood toppled a golden age of order and honor. Do you really believe this chaos is freedom?
Ordis Almost done, Teshin
Ordis Orphix fields are disabled. The Operator should be cleared to board.
Teshin No. Too easy. Let me nudge the snares first.
Ballas That's it. Come to me, old man. I am eager to show you how this war ends. Not with brutality, but with hope. Not with lies, but truth. A truth for all who are strong enough to believe. Even you.
Ballas Wake up, sleepyhead.
Ballas You're going to want to see this. Watch the Veil do its work.
Erra Call out, Dax.
Teshin Cool water flows. The moon, behind a cloud.
Teshin (grunts)
Teshin ... No!
Ballas He'll give in soon. They all will... and this war will be over before it even begins. Not with bombs and blood... but with truth. They programmed you and your kind. Now it is our turn to program them.
Erra Summon your devil. It's time.
Teshin Why? No! No! Valeria!
Ballas See the Veil work. Turning his memories inside out. Making him see the things he's lost. Putting pain where it serves us. A lost love, perhaps... her life, cut short by the very Tenno he had sworn to protect.
Erra Call out, old man. Give her justice, give her peace!
Teshin I-I can... see her... Tenno... why???
Erra One for the reject pile, then.
Ballas Goodbye, my love.
Natah Let me go, child. Let me go.
Operator I can't! I won't.
Operator (struggles)
Ballas You cannot kill the devil, Tenno!
Operator (struggles)
Ballas ...but you can send it back to hell!
Operator (grunts)
Operator (struggles)
Operator (winces)
Teshin grunts Teshin (grunts)
The Rise of Narmer Cutscene
Ballas All... as one.
Ballas I stand before you... last of my kind. An orphan of Tenno massacres. But their violence did not end with me, did it? It carried on... to all of you.
Ballas Grineer languished in their torture-plexes. Ostron clades starved for Tenno tithe. Corpus pupils weeping Tenno praise under blade. Solaris souls blackened the skies of Tenno foundries.
Ballas But now is our time. An era of peace and security. The devils have been cast out. And by the Void... the Tenno shall never return!
Earth
??? Spire due-south. Full detachment, veils on.
(Player)??? Comms are bad tonight. How many prisoners, you think?
??? Too deep to know for sure... but what if there's an Archon down there?
(Player)??? Don't do that.
Arriving at Narmer outpost gate
??? Patch in, and I'll release the door...
Inside Narmer outpost
??? Looks clear... but maybe an Archon--
(Player)??? --stay cool.
??? I have no idea what that means.
Arriving at Narmer vault
??? Let's hope you're not too late.
Cutscene Ostron No! No! Kruna metta! Please!
Ballas Ostron clades starved for Tenno tithe.
Ostron All as-- There! APOSTASY!
After killing all enemies
(Player)??? Easy now. I'm not going to hurt you... Let me get that thing off your face...
Ostron All as one. All as one. All as-
??? I told you! I told you! An Archon!
(Player)??? Call the ship, smart ass!
??? It'll be there! Just run!
(Player)??? Seal it!
After saving Ostron prisoners
Male Ostron Dah-dap, surah. Dah-dap.
Male Ostron Help the others. Kruna-metta.
Male Ostron Dah-dap. Sho-la.
Male Ostron Never will I submit to Narmer.
Male Ostron Dah-dap.
Female Ostron The Unum, did she send you? Does she live?
Female Ostron You will rescue the others, yes?
Female Ostron Do not succumb to the mask, surah. She gives, we live.
Female Ostron Do not concern yourself with me, surah.
Female Ostron Kruna-metta. My family, I must find them.
Female Ostron Release me, utz.
Female Ostron Ai yo.
Narmer Propaganda Ballas All as one.
Ballas A nightmare is over. Finally we see clearly. Finally we speak freely.
Ballas Savor the taste of liberty my friends. Don't ever relax your vigilance. All as one.
Ballas Future generations won't remember the Tenno oppression, but we do.
Ballas We bear the scars, we mourn the dead, and we must never allow ourselves to forget. All as one.
Ballas To those few who have yet to embrace Narmer, hear this we understand.
Ballas We see your fear, your hesitation, and we say come into the warm.
Ballas To those who imagined that any shall be rejected, hear this there is room for you too, in this better world.
Ballas But come sooner rather than later, for our pity shall only last so long. All as one.
Ballas They breed in the midnight places. A pestilence. You have known them of old. Told tales of their evil.
Ballas Stand strong. Stand together.
Ballas One cord alone may snap, but a rope woven of many cords may bind. All must do their part. All as one.
Ballas I saw a system divided, and I brought unity. I went over the orphans of war, and I brought peace.
Ballas My ears rang with a cacophany of chaos and I said Be still.
Ballas This bounty I give to you freely. Not the spoils of conquest, nor the profit of trade, but the gift of a loving father. All as one.
Ballas Just as a crystal lens first brought the heavenly bodies within the sight of man, so does the Veil show us the world as it truly is.
Ballas Seek out those who still walk within the smoke of confusion, and cry aloud for comfort. Take their hands and guide them into the light. All as one.
Ballas There are those who hate and fear the truth. And well they might. For the truth is a surgeon's scalpel and has no mercy for what is foul and diseased.
Ballas Purge, and purge again, until only the truth remains. All as one.
Drifter's Camp Nora Night How long's it been, since the Tenno left without sayin' goodbye? Since Narmer and the masks? Since the truth became a luxury few can lay their hands on? Whoever's picked up the mantle the Tenno dropped, driftin' wild, poppin' masks and loosin' bonds, whoever you may be, we salute you. Drifter.
Drifter Hey! Gimme that.
Drifter Alright... alright. Good to see you too.
Drifter What do you think, Ordis?
Ordis What do I think? I think --FINISH HER-- this is torture. What's left of her is just... just wasting away. We've tried everything. I have no 'care and feeding of Eidolons' in my data arrays. We don't know what we're dealing with.
Drifter No, we don't. But you know someone that does.
Ordis I know someone that--?! Wait. Operator, you can't be serious!
Drifter I told you. Don't call me that.
Ordis Sorry, Op-- Sorry. If you want to get to the Outer systems past Narmer, we'll need a Corpus shuttle.
Stolen Plates Fortuna For Narmer Healed, the pain of independence Strong, our wise and trusted friend We, united in one vision Rise to sing of sorrow's end
He, the bringer of the vision Bids you answer to his call Praise the wise and mighty Ballas Heed the ruler of us all
For we're all One And the work's begun For Narmer And we all run To our golden son For Narmer For Narmer
Ordis Vox Solaris collapsed under Narmer. You're on your own here. Keep your head down and get topside as quick as you can.
Ordis Wait. Deacons. They'll sense if you're not veiled. Give them a wide berth, or you'll be sucking black ooze before long.
Ordis Avoid the Deacons, or they'll seal you in!
Ambient
Drifter All as one.
Drifter All as one.
Drifter All as one.
Solaris Male All as one.
Almost to elevator
Little Duck Allo allo - missing your brain-buster then?
Ordis Ignore her. We can't risk it.
Little Duck Hah! Can't risk what? Jank-ciphered comms? Already blew it. But listen, if you're here to muck with Narmer, I'm keen to lift with ya.
Orb Vallis
Drifter 'Eh, need a ship, Corpus tags.
Little Duck Then you'll be wanting to pay a visit to that bleeding brain-buster factory. I know a shortcut. Might grab yourself a K-Drive if you've got the legs for it.
While on K-Drive
Little Duck Name's Little Duck. And you... you must be that stick in the spokes I've heard about. You weren't in with the Tenno back in the day, were ya?
Drifter Something like that.
Arriving at veil factory
Little Duck Fresh shipment of brain-busters... and there's one with your name on it. See... security's lax on account of how the only way inside is wearing one of those sticky things.
Ordis What? Op-- you-- you don't know what effect it will have on you. There's got to be a better way.
Little Duck 'Fraid not.
Killing all enemies
Little Duck Pops my plugs to think that some people take the veil by choice! Warm lies are more comfort than cold, hard truths, eh?
After putting on veil
Little Duck Ready? Veil up, and I'll mark the shuttle uplink once you're inside. Think happy thoughts, yeah?
Lotus My child... so beautiful to behold. How do you feel?
Lotus We found you within the derelict Zariman. Feral. Evil. Void in your heart... but Ballas... he saw a lost child in need of a father. As you recovered, he noticed me less and less. What good was I to him if you weren't sick?
Lotus I loved him, but he only loved you. The stasis dreams were the only choice I had. Your Zariman dreams of mother, father... I made them nightmares.
Lotus And it worked. You began to see Ballas not as the father, but as the phantom of your nightmares. He confined in me. The deeper your madness, the deeper our love. Ballas was mine.
Little Duck Blending in nice, but I'd still give those Deacons a wide berth. Did you know they can detonate those veils if they smell a rat?
Little Duck Ya shammin' brainless real nice, but I'd still give those Deacons a wide berth. They smell a rat, your Veil[sic] detonates. Take your whole face off an' no mistake.
Ordis Are you serious?! It didn't occur to you that you might want to mention that before we put one ON!?
Little Duck It did. And I didn't. Needed you focused.
Past the gate
Lotus But he could not be deceived for long. He saw through my deception, and my judgment was swift and true. He cradled you in his arms, saying 'Child--'
Ballas --Child, my child, forgive me. Wake from this horrid dream of hers. The world outside is waiting for you. These horrors of Zariman... are lies only to hold you ill. I... love you.
At console Drifter I can't...
Little Duck Oi! Focus! Jab that console, quick!
Little Duck Ah, guts! You've been rumbled! Right, leg it out the back before ya mumblin' with the rest! I've sorted your ship... and a little nugget for myself while I was there.
Exiting factory Little Duck Ah... takes me back to the good old Tenno days... expect those brain-busters might be on backorder for a while. Been a pleasure lifting with you, Drifter.
Drifter's Camp Nora Night Lovers... holdouts... I just got word on the wave. Narmhead factory got hit. No doubt the handiwork of that Drifter we've been hearing about. Feels good to have a little bit of truth in the world.
Ordis Navigation is marked... but I hope you change your mind.
Enemy of Enemies Grineer Shipyard on Uranus Ordis This confirms that you are clearly insane.
Drifter Peas in a filo-pod, Ordis. Stay close... in case I come to my senses.
Disciple Ka-Nuteru Exalted the dissident remains entrenched in the shadows below. The sea runs crimson with the blood of our faithful. But... I will prevail. In Narmer's name. All as one.
Disciple Ka-Nuteru The unclean spirit thins our herd from the shadows. It will not matter. My faith is too strong. The light of Narmer will bring it the truth. All as one.
Disciple Ka-Nuteru Only... only I remain. A test of my faith in trembling light. But! I am not afraid. Ballas will save me, his love is within me! All as One. All... as...
Meeting Hunhow Cutscene Hunhow Even the Golden Lord of Lies cannot kill you, Tenno.
Drifter She lives, Hunhow.
Hunhow No. She only lingers... and without her kind, not for long. Their search for her remains has long since begun. The Shadow can dispatch you swiftly. A mercy. The Archons will not...
Drifter What do they want?
Hunhow The same as you... to raise the dead. Only they have the power to do it... unlike you.
Hunhow You are just as incomplete as she is. No metal beasts. No Void fury. They will snap you in half and plant a veil on your face.
Drifter Not if you help me.
Hunhow Help you? Of course. What are friends for? Let me explain what you are up against, 'friend'. You see the Archons [...]
Hunhow [...] were made by my son, Erra. Hybrid abominations of the Old War... raised from the blighted battlefields where Sentient and Warframe fell.
Is that an Owl? Drifter Is that an Owl?
Hunhow The Owl is named Boreal. His trident strikes from a great distance... deadly, chaotic arcs. One might avoid them with a keen eye if you can anticipate their faint threads before.
Hunhow Even the very ground you walk upon will become Boreal's weapon. He may have a weakness at this moment, but it is not obvious.
Hunhow Worst of all is the paralyzing screech. Terrifying, yet this moment is your only chance to close in, unseen, and strike.
What do they call the Wolf? Drifter What do they call The[sic] Wolf?
Hunhow Amar. He will gnash his fang-blade, filling the air with deadly coils of flame.
Hunhow Survive the flame, and you might see frenzy. A relentless fury of slashes. Only the greatest of force will subdue him in this.
Hunhow Should he howl, the pack will appear. Mirrors of himself, meant to confuse. Only the true eye can distinguish the alpha among them.
I've seen the Snake before. Drifter I've seen the Snake before.
Hunhow You know Nira. The eldest. Her whip cracks with an Eidolon's wrath... bone-shattered shockwaves unleached by every unfurling of its tip.
Hunhow Her whip is more than pain; it is protection. And more... for if you stand in awe of its spiral, the great thunderclap that follows will knock you senseless. Though... she may be diminished somewhat by this exertion.
Hunhow And her gaze. To meet her gaze is certain death. Only by turning away would you hope to survive.
Hunhow Vainglorious whelp. That's it? Off you go to die? You have nothing to fight these beasts with! I cannot guess how many lives a Tenno has, but you seem eager to lose another.
Drifter I've got work to do. You can lay here all you want, doing nothing, wallowing in ancient grudges. She chose the Tenno. But Ballas and your groveling son... they used her. They'll do it again and again. Burning her up for whatever suits them and tossing the ashes when they're done. They cannot have her.
Hunhow Tenno. Wait.
Hunhow I have wallowed here, it is true, fading in this deep hole, waiting to die... but without release. Held here by a purpose I cannot abandon. That she... is free. So no. They cannot have her. But hear me - even if I help you, even if by some miracle you succeed... she will not be the same. Even for us... death... leaves a mark. Do you understand?
Drifter I understand.
Hunhow A weapon as old as those you hunt. Nataruk.
Sentients spawning Hunhow If you are worthy of Nataruk, you won't mind a little test, will you?
Hunhow Nataruk can fire fast and true... But you will need to time your release with the weapon's rhythm if you hope to pierce the blighted skin of an Archon.
Hunhow Archons will raise the dead to swarm you. But Nira is not the only one to call thunder.
Hunhow Even the mighty Archons will have their weaknesses, but not always exposed. You may need to wait to observe to find your opportunity.
Hunhow You are quick to it. But facing the Archon will not be as easy. You must study and prepare.
Outside of the sealab Ordis Oper- Uh... You. You're alive! I can hardly believe it. He actually agreed to help?
Drifter Yeah... bastard even gave me homework.
Temporal Axioms Ballas You cannot kill the devil, Tenno! ...but you can send it back to hell!
In Zariman Ten Zero Cephalon Melica Quiet down, please. Stand for pledges.
Zariman Students By the glory and wisdom of the Seven I give my life--
Jenva You wanna get detention again?
Zariman Students --To carry the sacred light of our dominion into the deepest dark. In this... we are one.
Cephalon Melica Save all that chitter chatter for Tau! Our jump schedule has changed again so we're moving exams up with it! Everyone has studied their Temporal Axioms unit I assume?
Mathon T.A.? But we were meant to have Phasics!
Cephalon Melica By my precepts, I've never had such an enthusiastic group of students! Now. Eyes of the main screen, and pay close attention!
Presentation Euleria Entrati Temporal Axioms - Unit 6. The Prison of Linear Time.
Presentism Euleria Entrati Presentism, the obsolete theory of linear time, posits that now is all that is real.
Event - Solar Genesis Euleria Entrati In this frame, the Present Absolute, the now, moves constantly toward the future.
Jenva When are we ever gonna use this stuff?
Monotemporal Progression = Entropic Escalation Euleria Entrati And leaves the static past behind, discarded, consigned to unreality.
Presumed Inevitability of Decay Euleria Entrati The future remains to be discovered, but is less real than even the past.
Event - Solar Extinction Euleria Entrati We see the shadows on the cave wall but not the hands that cast them.
Eternalism Theory of Void Travel / Polytemporal Nexus [See Chapter 7] Euleria Entrati The Void offers humanity the truer telling of Eternalism. That now is merely a facet of a great block.
Mathon My head hurts...
Meta-Event - Solar Totality Euleria Entrati It is relative... and we can change the frame.
Further Reading - 'Beyond the Wall of Lohk'. A. Entrati 'The Palimpsest of Spacetime'. A. and E. Entrati Euleria Entrati The tyranny of the Present Absolute is overthrown. Tomorrow is now its equal.
Taking quiz Cephalon Melica Students, eyes on your own screen.
Euleria Entrati Question One. Which of the following is not one of the Theories of Time?
Euleria Entrati Presentism.
Euleria Entrati Futurism.
Euleria Entrati Eternalism.
Which of the following is not one of the Theories of Time? A) Presentism Euleria Entrati Incorrect. Were you paying attention during the lecture? Try again.
B) Futurism Euleria Entrati Correct. Presentism and Eternalism are the principal Theories of Time.
C) Eternalism Euleria Entrati Incorrect. Were you paying attention during the lecture? Try again.
Euleria Entrati Question Two. What is the principal of failing Presentism?
Euleria Entrati It considers the Present to be the only reality.
Euleria Entrati It has never been endorsed by an Archimedean of unblemished standing.
Euleria Entrati It lacks elegance.
Euleria Entrati It is not true.
What is the principal of failing Presentism? A) It considers the Present to be the only reality. Euleria Entrati Correct. As the name implies, Presentism considers only the Present to be real.
B) It has never been endorsed by an Archimedean of unblemished standing. Euleria Entrati Incorrect. Prior to the discovery of the Void, many worthy Archimedeans of the past endorsed Presentism.
C) It lacks elegance. Euleria Entrati Partially correct. While elegance is a valid measure of worthness. The primary failing of Presentism is adequacy. Try again.
D) It is not true. Euleria Entrati Incorrect. We are not concerned here with absolute truths. Only with truth at a relative scale. Demerit applied. Try again.
Euleria Entrati Question Three. Lintana's parents have been captured, but she has a choice. The button that opens her mother's cell door will flood her father's cell with deadly radiation, and vise versa. She presses one of the buttons. Under Eternalism, which of the following statements is universally true?
Euleria Entrati Only one of her parents will survive.
Euleria Entrati Only one of her parents will die.
Euleria Entrati Her parents will survive. Her parents will die.
Lintana's parents have been captured, but she has a choice. The button that opens her mother's cell door will flood her father's cell with deadly radiation, and vise versa. She presses one of the buttons. Under Eternalism, which of the following statements is universally true? A) Only one of her parents will survive. Euleria Entrati Incorrect. Versions of reality now exist in which each parent dies. Lintana is assigned to one of them, but the other is no less real and is theoretically accessible.
B) Only one of her parents will die. Euleria Entrati Incorrect. Versions of reality now exist in which each parent dies. Lintana is assigned to one of them, but the other is no less real and is theoretically accessible.
C) Her parents will survive. Her parents will die. Euleria Entrati Correct. Versions of reality now exist in which each parent dies. Lintana is assigned to one of them, but the other is no less real and is theoretically accessible.
Zariman Announcer Pardon the interruption. This is 'Zariman actual'. All decks, all stations, stand by for Reliquary field drill.
Cephalon Melica Students, please direct your attention to the windows, you may find this instructive!
